review_type: purposeful narrative selection; not a systematic review
verification_method: Publisher/PubMed metadata checked against Europe PMC final article XML; GEO series/sample metadata and three Zenodo records checked live. These checks do not reproduce the published analyses.

papers.title: Exploring The Role of TOP2A in the Intersection of Pathogenic Mechanisms Between Rheumatoid Arthritis and Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis Based on Bioinformatics
papers.study_design: Reanalysis of public human disease/control expression cohorts with LASSO/SVM candidate selection, external transcriptomic validation, cell-line perturbation and mouse-model expression experiments

discovery_sources.metadata_note: Overall_design describes 43 donors; sample-level metadata adds 3 CLAD donors. The 139 libraries represent 46 donors in the full series.

experimental_models.compound: PluriSIn #2, used by authors to inhibit TOP2A

endpoints: Differential gene expression and disease/control ROC discrimination
Inflammatory/fibrogenic markers, migration/invasion and phospho-SMAD2/3 after cell-line perturbation

findings.model_validation: External GEO expression/ROC validation and qRT-PCR, Western blot and mouse-model expression support; not a validated drug-response model
findings.interpretation: Supports exploratory TOP2A-associated inflammatory/fibrogenic hypotheses. Does not establish direct TNF-TOP2A binding, adalimumab targeting TOP2A, or a clinically validated TOP2A test.

data_availability.public_individual_level_dataset: public expression and de-identified sample metadata in GEO; selected analysis subsets must be reconstructed
data_availability.access: Public GEO series records and sample metadata

evidence_limits: Cancer-derived SW982 and A549 cell lines limit disease-model generalisation
Proliferation/cell-cycle and cell-composition effects are alternative explanations requiring explicit testing in this project
Authors note lack of rescue experiments and incomplete mechanistic confirmation
Diagnostic disease/control ROC discrimination is not prospective disease progression or adalimumab-response prediction
GSE213001 has repeated lung-region samples; donor-level dependence must be handled
No adalimumab intervention or direct TNF-TOP2A binding measurement was performed

papers.title: Spatial patterning of fibroblast TGFβ signaling underlies treatment resistance in rheumatoid arthritis

prior_preprint.note: Final article changes remission definition and categorisation. Use 2026 final text for cohort labels; do not infer publication year from the DOI.

papers.study_design: Paired early-RA synovial-biopsy spatial-transcriptomic investigation with separate external expression cohorts, co-culture perturbations and RA patient-derived organoids

cohort.denominator_note: Different experiments/figures have distinct denominators; 17 patients are not 17 adalimumab patients, and cells or niches are not independent patient replicates.

endpoints: Final-article six-month remission: DAS28-ESR <2.6 AND DAS28-CRP <2.4; borderline meets only one condition
Tissue niche composition, fibrogenic COMP/TGF-beta/Notch signatures and spatial localisation
Gene/protein response to Notch and TGF-beta pathway perturbation in co-cultures and patient-derived organoids

findings.interpretation: Fibrogenic tissue programmes are associated with lack of remission despite immune depletion; a mechanistic context for investigating anti-TNF response, not demonstration of a TOP2A-adalimumab mechanism.

data_availability.public_individual_level_dataset: public spatial transcriptomic and selected clinical/source data; no large dataset files downloaded during this review

generated_data.role: Custom fibrogenesis panel and AMP Olink matrix
RA-ILD lung/synovium, patient-derived organoids, 3D co-cultures and 396.10 Olink

evidence_limits: Small biopsy cohort and only six adalimumab-treated patients
Mechanistic perturbation models do not establish clinical efficacy of an additional treatment
Direct TOP2A biology or binding to TNF/adalimumab is not established by this study
Analyses must account for participant-level replication and distinct figure denominators
Final peer-reviewed article is from 2026; the 2025 PMC record supplied initially is a preprint

papers.title: Therapeutic serum level for adalimumab in rheumatoid arthritis: explorative analyses of data from a randomised phase III trial
papers.study_design: Post hoc longitudinal concentration-outcome analysis of a 48-week randomised phase III biosimilarity trial (ADMYRA); not a randomised trial of concentration-guided dosing
endpoints: DAS28-ESR remission and low disease activity

findings.crp_association: Lower CRP at trough concentrations at or above 3.9 mg/L
findings.interpretation: The approximately 4 mg/L proposal is population-specific association evidence, not a universal threshold or demonstrated benefit of dosing intervention.

data_availability.access: Data available from Sandoz upon reasonable request

evidence_limits: Post hoc concentration-response associations are not randomised exposure comparisons
Stringent trial inclusion criteria limit external validity
All participants received methotrexate; cannot isolate its influence on drug levels or immunogenicity
Selected continuation after week 24 and changing denominators require care
Does not establish thresholds for psoriasis, AS or lupus

structural_foundation_not_counted_in_rec.title: Comparison of the inhibition mechanisms of adalimumab and infliximab in treating tumor necrosis factor alpha-associated diseases from a molecular view
structural_foundation_not_counted_in_rec.coordinate_content: TNF-alpha with adalimumab Fab; not full-length adalimumab IgG
structural_foundation_not_counted_in_rec.asymmetric_unit: One TNF chain plus one Fab light chain and one Fab heavy chain; full TNF trimer depiction requires verified crystallographic transformations

supplementary_reference_not_a_fourth_rev.role: RA/AS context for assay comparison; not an efficacy trial

regulatory_safety_context.scope: RA, PsA, AS and plaque psoriasis appear among labelled indications; SLE does not. Section 5.9 discusses lupus-like syndrome as a potential adverse effect.

project_evidence_limits: No complete TOP2A-TNF-adalimumab molecular or clinical causal link is established by the selected papers
TOP2A may reflect proliferation or cell composition; this is an alternative hypothesis to test, not a demonstrated explanation for these datasets
Disease/control expression datasets do not automatically contain treatment-response labels
Independent cohorts cannot be joined as if they share patients or patient-specific structures
The central papers provide no urine-analysis dataset or validation of adalimumab treatment for lupus
The 2013 TNF-Fab structure is foundational, not one of the three recent studies
Narrative review is not an original experimental result; no article full text or identifying patient data is committed
selection_basis: Exploratory RA-TOP2A-TNF hypothesis and adalimumab-response context; broader disease and DNA/RNA questions remain separate research lanes

supplementary_papers_not_counted_in_cent.title: Identifying Predictive Biomarkers of Response in Patients With Rheumatoid Arthritis Treated With Adalimumab Using Machine Learning Analysis of Whole-Blood Transcriptomics Data

publication_dates.note: Publisher and PubMed/PMC online-date fields differ; both establish publication year 2025.

supplementary_papers_not_counted_in_cent.study_design: Prospective observational BRAGGSS cohort; paired bulk whole-blood RNA-seq and exploratory classifier/network analyses
endpoints: EULAR response at month 6 based on DAS28-CRP; month-3 score substituted for four patients lacking month-6 score
Anti-adalimumab antibody detection over available month-3, month-6 and month-12 samples

findings.interpretation: MZB1 is an exploratory transcriptomic candidate associated with immunogenicity, not a clinically validated predictive test.

data_availability.access: Data and model objects available upon researcher request under University of Manchester governance

evidence_limits: Small and imbalanced cohort; independent replication required
Association does not establish causal control of drug response
Does not measure TNF-Fab structure or establish lupus treatment efficacy

supplementary_papers_not_counted_in_cent.title: Transcriptomic profiling and machine learning uncover gene signatures of psoriasis endotypes and disease severity
supplementary_papers_not_counted_in_cent.study_design: Prospective observational PSORT discovery and replication cohorts during routine adalimumab or ustekinumab treatment
endpoints: Associations of transcriptomic modules/factors with BMI, HLA and treatment exposure

findings.interpretation: Severity-associated transcriptomic signatures; not proof of drug-specific prospective response prediction or causal treatment superiority.

data_availability.public_individual_level_dataset: limited processed expression and phenotype data

evidence_limits: Routine treatment allocation was not randomised
Repeated samples require patient-level train/test grouping
Current disease-severity prediction differs from prospective treatment-response prediction
Cannot join these individuals to structural measurements or the independent RA cohorts
